note_schemas: 2.8 curated tool schemas (L-CORE7-2, L-AIH-7): hand-written input schemas and descriptions for the tools AI hosts use most. The generator refuses a curated schema that omits a key the function reads, or adds one it does not read; provenance becomes 'curated'.
note_output_schemas: 2.8 parts 3-6 (9032, 9033, 9034, 9035): output schemas for every MCP read tool and the draft tools, all field-level with required keys: draft tools, balances, whoami, FX rate, snapshots, registry search and handoff status (9032-9033); the report families require the rpt_envelope keys and type their own keys; the read tools of 9034 are field-level since 9035 (required = keys the body always builds; null where the body can make null; keys inside jsonb_strip_nulls objects required only when never null). Report rows stay array/object (D-OUT-1). The Gateway refuses an MCP result that does not match (OUTPUT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH). Contract: every bnx_app call in every Python suite is checked (tests/py/jsonschema_lite.py via the harness), plus AT-OUT-01 and AT-OUT-03.
